judged_text: The member-adding UI is now only rendered inside {{#if id}}, so the previous flow of creating a new group together with its initial members (old template rendered user-selector unconditionally and createWithUsernames submitted them) is no longer possible. Admins who previously typed a name and usernames and hit save once must now create an empty group, wait for it to appear, then add members in a second step — a silently removed capability of the admin workflow that no iteration note or changelog marks as accepted.

adjudication.rationale: The diff verifiably removes the ability to create a group and submit initial members in the same save step: `group.hbs` now renders the member list and the "add members" user-selector only inside `{{#if id}}` (so it won’t show for a new/unsaved group), and `admin-group.js.es6` changes `save` to call `group.create()` / `group.save()` instead of `createWithUsernames(this.get('usernames'))` / `saveWithUsernames(...)`. Membership addition is moved to a separate `addMembers` action/endpoint (`PUT /admin/groups/:id/members.json`). This is a real workflow/feature regression, but it’s not necessarily a correctness defect if the new two-step flow is intentional.
